title: ice Q Gourmetrestaurant Sölden
highlights: Spectacular gourmet restaurant located at 3,048 meters above sea level on Gaislachkogel
Striking glass and steel architecture featured as Hoffler Klinik in James Bond: Spectre
Refined Alpine haute cuisine accompanied by exclusive wine tastings

kurzbeschreibung: The futuristic gourmet restaurant ice Q on the summit of the Gaislachkogel in Sölden is world-famous as a James Bond filming location.
beschreibung:
Haute Cuisine at over 3,000 Meters

The ice Q on the summit of the Gaislachkogel in Sölden completely redefines alpine fine dining. Nestled in a breathtaking high-alpine landscape at 3,048 meters above sea level, the restaurant fascinates with purist architecture of glass and steel that clings seamlessly to the mountain ridge.

Setting of Cinematic History

The building gained worldwide renown as the futuristic Hoffler clinic in the James Bond blockbuster Spectre. Today, ice Q brings together visionary architecture, sophisticated gourmet cuisine, exquisite wines from around the globe, and panoramic views across more than 250 three-thousand-meter peaks of the Ötztaler Alpen.
